verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents its own streaming capability: responses are sent back in chunks and displayed incrementally as the model generates them, which covers the core of responsive streamed completions. The evidence does not say the transport is Server-Sent Events or that chunks are per-token, so the story is only partly covered. missing for 10: explicit documentation that streaming uses SSE, confirmation of token-by-token chunk granularity, independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream completions token by token over SSE for responsive user experiences

citations.quote: The Cerebras API supports streaming responses, which send messages back in chunks and display them incrementally as the model generates them.
